stepTitle: Two children push on opposite sides of a door during play. Both push horizontally and perpendicular to the door. One child pushes with a force of $$17.5\, \text{N}$$ at a distance of $$0.600\, \text{m}$$ from the hinges, and the second child pushes at a distance of $$0.450\, \text{m}.$$ What force must the second child exert to keep the door from moving? Assume friction is negligible. Give the force to three significant figures (in $$\text{N})$$.
